claims.text: Applies to: sterilizations paid for by Medicaid.
claims.quote: This subpart applies to sterilizations and hysterectomies reimbursed under Medicaid.

claims.text: Age: at least 21 years old when consent is signed.
claims.quote: (a) The individual is at least 21 years old at the time consent is obtained;

claims.text: Waiting period: at least 30 days (and no more than 180 days) between consent and the procedure.
claims.quote: (d) At least 30 days, but not more than 180 days, have passed between the date of informed consent and the date of the sterilization, except in the case of premature delivery or emergency abdominal surgery.

claims.text: Exception: premature delivery or emergency abdominal surgery may proceed if at least 72 hours have passed since consent.
claims.quote: An individual may consent to be sterilized at the time of a premature delivery or emergency abdominal surgery, if at least 72 hours have passed since he or she gave informed consent for the sterilization.

claims.text: Invalid consent: consent can't be obtained during labor or childbirth, while seeking or getting an abortion, or under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
claims.quote:
Informed consent may not be obtained while the individual to be sterilized is—
(1) In labor or childbirth;
(2) Seeking to obtain or obtaining an abortion; or
(3) Under the influence of alcohol or other substances that affect the individual's state of awareness.

claims.text: Not covered: no Medicaid funding to sterilize a mentally incompetent or institutionalized person.
claims.quote: FFP is not available for the sterilization of a mentally incompetent or institutionalized individual.
